expertise.hint: This sets how simple or detailed CHIMS looks. You can change it any time in Settings.

expertise.technician_desc: I carry out innovation work: ideas, projects, tasks.
expertise.specialist_desc: I design and tune innovation programs and criteria.
expertise.manager_desc: I own the innovation system. Show me everything.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.hint: Everything that makes up your innovation system: the people, resources, concepts and activities, and how they relate.

emptyHint.person: Add the people who take part in innovation: your team, customers, partners, experts.
emptyHint.resource: Add what you use: budgets, tools, spaces, data, incentives.
emptyHint.concept: Add ideas, knowledge, frameworks and the culture you work in.
emptyHint.activity: Add what gets done: processes, projects, programs, training.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this item and its relationships? This cannot be undone.

ideas.hint: Propose ideas, evaluate them with clear criteria, and decide which ones to build.
ideas.emptyHint: Be the first: describe a problem or an opportunity in a few lines.
ideas.formHint: Keep it short. You can always add detail later.
ideas.criteriaHint: Choose the criteria for this idea and how much each one counts (1 to 5).

gateCriteria.launch_ready: Everything needed to launch is in place

projects.emptyHint: Approve an idea and turn it into a project, or start a project from scratch.

projects.gateHint: All criteria must be met before the project can move on.

projects.unmet_one: {{count}} criterion still to meet before you can move on.
projects.unmet_other: {{count}} criteria still to meet before you can move on.

iso56002.name: ISO 56002 innovation management system
iso56002.description: The international standard for managing innovation: understand your context, set a strategy, plan, support, run the innovation process, measure and improve.

context.title: Understand the organization and its context
context.description: Study customers, market, competitors and internal strengths that shape innovation.

strategy.title: Set the innovation vision and strategy
strategy.description: Decide where innovation should take the business and how.

planning.title: Plan innovation objectives and initiatives
planning.description: Turn the strategy into objectives, budgets and a plan of initiatives.

opportunities.title: Identify opportunities
opportunities.description: Collect needs, problems and ideas from inside and outside the business.

concepts.title: Create and validate concepts
concepts.description: Shape promising ideas into concepts and check that they make sense.

solutions.title: Develop and deploy solutions
solutions.description: Build the validated concepts and bring them to the market or into operations.

evaluation.title: Evaluate innovation performance
evaluation.description: Measure results against objectives and review them with management.

improvement.title: Improve the system
improvement.description: Act on what the evaluation shows to make the innovation system better.

stage_gate.name: Stage-Gate
stage_gate.description: A staged path from discovery to launch, with a decision gate between each stage. Good for structured product development.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: Look for opportunities and collect raw ideas.

scoping.title: Scoping
scoping.description: Make a quick, low-cost assessment of the most promising ideas.

business_case.title: Build the business case
business_case.description: Define the product, the market, the cost and the expected return.

development.title: Development
development.description: Design and build the product or service.

testing.title: Testing and validation
testing.description: Test the solution with real users and in real conditions.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: Bring the product or service to market.

gate_reviews.title: Gate reviews
gate_reviews.description: Decide at each gate whether to go on, hold or stop.

design_thinking.name: Design Thinking
design_thinking.description: A human-centred way to solve problems: understand people, define the real problem, imagine, prototype and test.

empathize.title: Empathize
empathize.description: Observe and listen to the people you are designing for.

define.title: Define the problem
define.description: State clearly the problem worth solving.

ideate.title: Ideate
ideate.description: Generate many ideas, then choose the best ones.

prototype.title: Prototype
prototype.description: Build quick, simple versions to make ideas tangible.

test.title: Test
test.description: Try the prototypes with users and learn from their reactions.

lean_startup.name: Lean Startup
lean_startup.description: Learn fast with little money: test your riskiest assumptions with a simple product and decide from real data.

assumptions.title: Identify the riskiest assumptions
assumptions.description: List what must be true for the idea to work.

build.title: Build a minimum viable product
build.description: Make the smallest version that can test the assumptions.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Collect real data on how customers behave.

learn.title: Learn and decide
learn.description: Decide whether to pivot, persevere or stop.

double_diamond.name: Double Diamond
double_diamond.description: A design process in two diamonds: first understand the right problem, then build the right solution. Each diamond opens up to many options and then narrows down.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: Explore the problem widely: talk to people and look at the market.

define.title: Define
define.description: Narrow down to a clear problem worth solving.

develop.title: Develop
develop.description: Generate many possible solutions and try them out.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.description: Choose the best solution, finalize it and release it.

design_sprint.name: Design Sprint
design_sprint.description: Answer a big question in five days: map the problem, sketch, decide, build a prototype and test it with real customers.

understand.title: Understand
understand.description: Map the challenge and pick a target to focus on.

sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.description: Each person sketches solutions on their own.

decide.title: Decide
decide.description: Choose the best sketches and turn them into a plan.

prototype.title: Prototype
prototype.description: Build a realistic prototype in one day.

test.title: Test
test.description: Watch five customers use the prototype and learn from them.

open_innovation.name: Open innovation
open_innovation.description: Innovate with partners outside your company: universities, startups, suppliers and customers bring in ideas and technology.

scouting.title: Scout for partners
scouting.description: Look for outside ideas, technologies and partners that fit your needs.

partnering.title: Agree on partnerships
partnering.description: Define what each side brings and how results are shared.

cocreate.title: Co-create
cocreate.description: Develop solutions together with your partners.

integrate.title: Bring it in-house
integrate.description: Integrate the results into your products and operations.

blue_ocean.name: Blue Ocean strategy
blue_ocean.description: Stop competing in crowded markets. Create new demand by changing what you offer and what you leave out.

canvas.title: Draw the strategy canvas
canvas.description: Show how you and your competitors compete today.

four_actions.title: Eliminate, reduce, raise, create
four_actions.description: Decide what to remove, lower, raise or invent to offer new value.

validate.title: Test with customers
validate.description: Check that the new offer is attractive and sustainable.

rollout.title: Roll out
rollout.description: Launch the new offer to the market.

jobs_to_be_done.name: Jobs to be done
jobs_to_be_done.description: Understand the job customers hire a product for, then design offers that do that job better.

interview.title: Interview customers
interview.description: Ask about recent purchases and what they were trying to get done.

map_jobs.title: Map the jobs
map_jobs.description: List the jobs, the steps and what makes each one hard.

find_gaps.title: Find the gaps
find_gaps.description: Spot the important jobs that are poorly served today.

design_offer.title: Design the offer
design_offer.description: Shape a product or service around the job.

check.title: Check with customers
check.description: See whether customers would hire the new offer.

three_horizons.name: Three horizons
three_horizons.description: Balance your innovation across three time frames: improve the core now, grow emerging bets, and explore future options.

horizon1.title: Horizon 1: improve the core
horizon1.description: Make today’s business more efficient and profitable.

horizon2.title: Horizon 2: grow emerging bets
horizon2.description: Back the new offers that are starting to work.

horizon3.title: Horizon 3: explore the future
horizon3.description: Run small experiments on possible futures.

balance.title: Balance the portfolio
balance.description: Decide how to split time and money across the three horizons.

business_model_generation.name: Business Model Generation
business_model_generation.description: Design, test and refine a business model on a single page, following the Business Model Canvas approach.

mobilize.title: Mobilize
mobilize.description: Set the goal, form the team and plan the work.

understand.title: Understand
understand.description: Gather what you need to know about customers, market and competitors.

design.title: Design
design.description: Sketch several business models on the canvas and choose the best.

implement.title: Implement
implement.description: Put the chosen model into practice.

manage.title: Manage
manage.description: Watch results and adapt the model over time.

value_proposition_design.name: Value Proposition Design
value_proposition_design.description: Make sure what you offer matches what customers really need: describe the customer, describe your offer, then check the fit.

customer_profile.title: Describe the customer
customer_profile.description: List the jobs, pains and gains of your customer.

value_map.title: Describe your offer
value_map.description: List the products and how they relieve pains and create gains.

fit.title: Check the fit
fit.description: Compare the two and mark what is still an assumption.

test.title: Test with customers
test.description: Run small experiments to prove or disprove the assumptions.

customer_development.name: Customer Development
customer_development.description: Find customers before you scale: discover their needs, validate your offer, create demand, then build the company.

discovery.title: Customer discovery
discovery.description: Talk to customers to test your guesses about the problem.

validation.title: Customer validation
validation.description: Show that customers will really buy, with a repeatable way to sell.

creation.title: Customer creation
creation.description: Build demand and grow the customer base.

company_building.title: Company building
company_building.description: Turn the learning into a company that can scale.

triz.name: TRIZ
triz.description: A method for solving technical problems by finding the contradiction behind them and applying proven inventive principles.

define.title: Define the problem
define.description: Describe the problem and what the ideal result would be.

contradiction.title: Find the contradiction
contradiction.description: State what improves and what gets worse when you try to fix it.

principles.title: Apply inventive principles
principles.description: Use the standard TRIZ principles to generate solutions.

evaluate.title: Evaluate the solutions
evaluate.description: Compare solutions with the ideal result and keep the best.

systematic_inventive_thinking.name: Systematic Inventive Thinking
systematic_inventive_thinking.description: Create new ideas without leaving your existing product: change it with five simple thinking tools.

closed_world.title: Define the closed world
closed_world.description: List the parts and features of your product or service.

tools.title: Apply the five tools
tools.description: Subtract, multiply, divide, unify tasks and make attributes depend on each other.

evaluate.title: Evaluate the ideas
evaluate.description: Keep the ideas that have real value for customers.

creative_problem_solving.name: Creative Problem Solving
creative_problem_solving.description: A step-by-step way to tackle open problems: understand them, generate many ideas, shape the best ones, and plan the action.

clarify.title: Clarify
clarify.description: Explore the situation and define the real challenge.

ideate.title: Generate ideas
ideate.description: Produce many ideas without judging them.

develop.title: Develop solutions
develop.description: Pick promising ideas and improve them.

implement.title: Plan the action
implement.description: Decide who does what, and by when.

scenario_planning.name: Scenario planning
scenario_planning.description: Prepare for an uncertain future by imagining several plausible scenarios and testing your strategy against each.

scope.title: Define the scope
scope.description: Choose the question and time horizon.

drivers.title: Identify the key drivers
drivers.description: List the forces and uncertainties that shape the future.

build.title: Build scenarios
build.description: Write a small set of different, plausible futures.

implications.title: Draw implications
implications.description: Decide what you would do in each scenario.

monitor.title: Monitor signals
monitor.description: Watch for early signs of which scenario is unfolding.

value_engineering.name: Value Engineering
value_engineering.description: Improve value by looking at what a product or process must do, then finding better or cheaper ways to do it.

information.title: Gather information
information.description: Collect facts on costs, requirements and use.

function.title: Analyse the functions
function.description: List what each part must do and what it costs.

creativity.title: Find alternatives
creativity.description: Generate other ways to deliver each function.

evaluation.title: Evaluate the alternatives
evaluation.description: Choose the options with the best value.

proposal.title: Propose and follow up
proposal.description: Present the change and track its results.

design_for_six_sigma.name: Design for Six Sigma
design_for_six_sigma.description: Design a new product or process right the first time, using data to meet customer needs with very few defects.

define.title: Define
define.description: Set the goals and the customer needs.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Turn customer needs into measurable requirements.

analyze.title: Analyse
analyze.description: Explore design options and choose the best.

design.title: Design
design.description: Detail the design and plan how to check it.

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: Test the design and hand it over to operations.

crowdsourcing.name: Crowdsourcing
crowdsourcing.description: Ask a large community, inside or outside your company, to contribute ideas or solutions to a clear challenge.

challenge.title: Define the challenge
challenge.description: Write a clear question, rules and reward.

launch.title: Launch to the crowd
launch.description: Open the challenge and invite people to take part.

select.title: Evaluate contributions
select.description: Review what came in and pick the best.

reward.title: Reward and implement
reward.description: Thank contributors and put winning ideas to work.

human_centered_design.name: Human-centered design
human_centered_design.description: Design with the people you serve: listen to them, build solutions together, and bring them to life.

hear.title: Hear
hear.description: Listen to people and learn about their lives and needs.

create.title: Create
create.description: Turn what you heard into ideas and quick prototypes.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.description: Plan how to launch and sustain the solution.

programs.title: Programs
programs.hint: A program is how innovation gets done: activities performed by people, using resources, to produce ideas and results.
programs.emptyHint: Start from a proven methodology or build your own from scratch.
programs.newHint: Pick a methodology to start from. Everything can be changed afterwards.
programs.scratchHint: An empty program: you add the activities, people and resources yourself.
programs.helpHint: Answer three quick questions and we will suggest where to start. You can still pick any methodology.

q.maturity: How much innovation work have you done so far?

need.customer: Understand customers and design new offers
need.validate: Test a new business idea quickly

programs.name: Program name
programs.noActivities: No activities yet. Add the first one below.
programs.removeHint: Tap an item to remove it from this activity.
programs.searchExisting: Search or type a new name
programs.deleteHint: The program is removed. Its activities and people stay in your Inventory.

ideas_submitted.name: Ideas submitted
ideas_submitted.hint: Counts the ideas people have proposed.

ideas_approved.name: Ideas approved
ideas_approved.hint: Counts the ideas that were approved.

projects_shipped.name: Projects shipped
projects_shipped.hint: Counts the projects that passed the last gate and were shipped.

projects_active.name: Active projects
projects_active.hint: How many projects are running right now.

inventory_count.name: Items in the Inventory
inventory_count.hint: Counts items in the Inventory, for example people, tools or concepts.

idea_score_avg.name: Average idea score
idea_score_avg.hint: The average weighted score of all evaluated ideas, from 1 to 5.

manual.name: Entered by hand
manual.hint: You type the value yourself, for example hours of training done.

goals.title: Goals and KPIs
goals.hint: Set what you want to achieve and watch it move. Each goal is measured by a KPI that CHIMS calculates from your data.
goals.emptyHint: Start with something simple, like collecting 20 ideas this quarter.
goals.emptyKpisHint: KPIs are created with your goals, or on their own here.
goals.formHint: A goal is a target on something you can measure.

step1.title: What do you want to achieve?
step1.hint: Describe the result in one sentence, then say what it is about.

step2.title: How will you measure it?
step2.hint: Pick something that CHIMS can count for you, or enter the number yourself.

step3.title: What number are you aiming for?
step3.hint: A goal needs a number and a unit, so you know when you have reached it.

step4.title: By when?
step4.hint: A goal without a deadline is only a wish. Pick a date.

goals.kpiFormHint: A KPI is a measure you want to keep an eye on.
goals.deleteConfirm: Delete this goal? This cannot be undone.
goals.deleteKpiConfirm: Delete this KPI and its history? Goals that use it lose their measure.
goals.dueInvalid: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-31.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.hint: Know your innovation field, state the assumptions behind your choices, and keep a versioned strategy.
strategy.driftBody: {{changed}} of the {{total}} assumptions behind this strategy have changed since it was written.
strategy.dueBody: Check them to see if they still hold.
strategy.fieldHint: Your innovation field is everything that can bring or inspire innovation in your business: people, resources, concepts and activities, including culture. “Monitored” means someone keeps an eye on it.
strategy.fieldEstimate: How many do you think exist? (optional)
strategy.fieldEmpty: Nothing in the Inventory yet. Add items there first.
strategy.assumptionsHint: An assumption is a reason behind a choice to use, or not use, something. Writing it down lets you check it later.
strategy.noAssumptionsHint: Start with the biggest choice you made, for example why you do not use a certain tool.
strategy.strategiesHint: A strategy describes what you use, what you do not use and why. Each version is kept, so you can see how your choices changed.
strategy.noStrategiesHint: Create the first one to describe how things are today.
strategy.summaryPlaceholder: In a few lines: what does this strategy aim for, and what are its main choices?
strategy.investmentsHint: Put how much you invest in each activity. Zero means the activity is not used.
strategy.noActivities: No activities yet. Add them in Programs or the Inventory.
strategy.noAssumptionsYet: Add an assumption first to explain why.
strategy.activateHint: The current strategy is archived and a transition is recorded.
strategy.deleteDraftConfirm: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.

assumption.formHint: We will help you write it so it can be checked later.
assumption.statementPlaceholder: e.g. We do not use an idea platform because our team is too small to need one
assumption.trigger: What change would make this false?
assumption.triggerPlaceholder: e.g. The team grows beyond 15 people
assumption.triggerHint: A good assumption says what would invalidate it. This is what tells you when to review the strategy.
assumption.reviewHint: Does this still hold? Record what you found.
assumption.acceptRisk: Keep the strategy as it is, accepting the risk if invalid
assumption.deleteConfirm: Delete this assumption? Strategies that rest on it lose that link.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.hint: What needs your attention across the business.

vote_needed.title: Score “{{title}}”
vote_needed.body: This idea is in evaluation and you have not given your scores yet.

idea_waiting.title: “{{title}}” is waiting

gate_due.label: Gate decision
gate_due.title: “{{title}}” is ready for review
gate_due.body: All exit criteria are met. Decide whether to pass the gate.

goal_at_risk.label: Goal at risk
goal_at_risk.title: “{{title}}” is behind
goal_at_risk.body: Progress is behind where it should be for the deadline.

strategy_review.label: Strategy
strategy_review.title: Time to review the strategy?
strategy_review.body: {{changed}} of {{total}} assumptions have changed since it was written.
